data.title: 摩根 · 冬宫雪庭
data.description: 【摩根 · 冬宫雪庭】冬宫的雪庭里，摩根独自立于漫天飞雪之中，黑蓝长裙与银发几乎融进雪光，只有王冠与冰瞳仍是触目的冷色——「雪落无声，正如王座之上的岁月。」
data.action: 独自站在雪庭空地，双手轻合在身前，抬眼看落雪
data.camera: full-body frontal shot, solitary standing figure in open snowy garden
data.promptProse: Alone in the Winter Palace snow garden, Morgan stands with hands loosely joined before her layered black-and-blue skirt, lifting icy blue eyes toward falling flakes. Snow settles on gown edges beneath her crown and silver-white hair. The frontal full-body view leaves undisturbed ground around her and bare branches farther back. Reflected snowlight gently reveals the skirt's darker folds and sleeve shapes, with a soft shadow at her feet.
